newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices ease, Kenyans unquoted.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices ease, Kenyans unquoted.

text.p: Bremen arabica prices were off $3-16 on the week per 50 kg fob in line with futures, with Kenyan material sold out as the season finished.
Kenya will resume "fly crop" auctions on July 22.
Consumers welcomed the price falls, which they said brought raw materials more closely in line with retail prices, but they still viewed differentials as too high.
Among reported trades were Brazilian shipments for Sept/Nov while Colombian and Central American differentials were cut.
Buyers were studying material from Burundi and New Guinea.
Robusta sellers withstood consumer calls for lower prices.
